papers.title: A radiographic world model for clinical reasoning and evidence generation (MedDream)
papers.authors: Xi, Hu, Wang, Safari et al. (11 authors)
papers.what: Learns one continuous latent state from 2.65 million leakage-controlled chest radiograph-text pairs and reads it out for both diagnosis and report-conditioned image generation, raising resident concordance with radiologist consensus from 56.3 to 63.0 percent and external VinDr-CXR macro-AUROC from 76.4 to 81.4 percent, with generation targeted at a prespecified subgroup gap adding 3.1 weighted-F1 points where unguided augmentation lost 2.3.
papers.builds_on: UNI Pathology (Chen 2023, 6T29JLTN); DDPM (Ho 2020, GX7WR7KA); World Models (Ha 2018, 938DAXZT)

papers.title: Where Does the Sound Go? Tracing Acoustic Information Loss in Audio-Conditioned LLMs
papers.what: Probes an audio-conditioned language model after the encoder, after the projector, inside the language model, and at the head, and finds that discriminative acoustic information survives to the last hidden layer, that replacing Whisper with reconstruction codecs does not fix acoustic underuse, and that tuning only the output head's letter rows recovers most of the multiple-choice accuracy gap.

papers.title: TempCloze: Can Video-LLMs Identify the Missing Middle?
papers.authors: Pei, Zhao, Liu, Meng, Chen, Wang, Du (HKU)
papers.what: Replaces text answer options with video ones in a cloze task over 1,521 long-take and egocentric videos, using same-source distractors that separate semantics, temporal alignment, and progression, and finds across 31 video language models that alignment, not semantics, is the bottleneck.
papers.builds_on: Video Action Survey (Zhu 2020, RYGRHCG3); Flamingo (Alayrac 2022, SC8KWYVK); BLIP-2 (Li 2023, 4N5WXKPI)

papers.title: Recursive Code World Models: Building Complex Worlds through Recursive Scene Programs
papers.what: Reconstructs a 3D world as executable scene code from a single image using a solver that recurses global-local-global, with a mandatory return visit to the parent scope after children are refined so that boundaries and spatial relations stay consistent, guided by a vision-language agent comparing renders against the reference.
papers.builds_on: PyVision (Zhao 2025, XQTY5MPI); ADaPT (Prasad 2023, J8DYBKW2); World Models (Ha 2018, 938DAXZT)
